name: ai-ui-performance
description: Experimental Windows resource diagnostics and reversible CPU scheduling profiles.

interface.longDescription: Inspect Windows resource usage and optionally apply or restore narrowly scoped CPU scheduling profiles for verified desktop executables. Shared-browser profiles require explicit opt-in because unrelated tabs may be affected. Experimental: controlled testing has not established a UI speed benefit. Runs on demand with no telemetry or background service. Does not lower RAM use or accelerate remote responses.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-ui-performance to inspect desktop resource pressure. Explain experimental limits; do not apply a profile.

publication.release_notes: Privacy correction: explicit data use, recipients, retention and controls. Process arguments are no longer inspected; scheduling is limited to verified window-owning processes. Existing undo records remain restorable. No UI speed benefit is established.
